content:
You plan to visit 10 European cities for 32 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You want to spend 3 days in Stockholm. You plan to stay in Hamburg for 5 days. You would like to visit Florence for 2 days. You would like to visit Istanbul for 5 days. From day 25 to day 29, there is a annual show you want to attend in Istanbul. You would like to visit Oslo for 5 days. You would like to visit Vilnius for 5 days. You plan to stay in Santorini for 2 days. You plan to stay in Munich for 5 days. You would like to visit Frankfurt for 4 days. You want to spend 5 days in Krakow. You have to attend a workshop in Krakow between day 5 and day 9.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Oslo and Stockholm, Krakow and Frankfurt, Krakow and Istanbul, Munich and Stockholm, Hamburg and Stockholm, from Krakow to Vilnius, Oslo and Istanbul, Istanbul and Stockholm, Oslo and Krakow, Vilnius and Istanbul, Oslo and Vilnius, Frankfurt and Istanbul, Oslo and Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg, Munich and Istanbul, Oslo and Munich, Frankfurt and Florence, Oslo and Hamburg, Vilnius and Frankfurt, from Florence to Munich, Krakow and Munich, Hamburg and Istanbul, Frankfurt and Stockholm, from Stockholm to Santorini, Frankfurt and Munich, from Santorini to Oslo, Krakow and Stockholm, from Vilnius to Munich, Frankfurt and Hamburg.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 32 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

Below is one valid solution. In this plan the 10 cities are visited in the order shown. Note that the “flight‐day overlap” rules force the first seven “blocks” to add up to 31 days so that the 8th city (Istanbul) gets an itinerary exactly covering days 25–29. (Also, the Krakow visit – required to include a workshop day between Day 5–9 – comes first so that Day 5 occurs in Krakow.) 

Here is one itinerary that meets all the requirements and uses only the following direct flights between successive cities:

• From Krakow to Vilnius (using the directed flight “from Krakow to Vilnius”)  
• From Vilnius to Frankfurt (vilnius and frankfurt are connected)  
• From Frankfurt to Florence (frankfurt and florence are connected)  
• From Florence to Munich (using the directed “from Florence to Munich”)  
• From Munich to Hamburg (munich and hamburg are connected)  
• From Hamburg to Oslo (oslo and hamburg are connected)  
• From Oslo to Istanbul (oslo and istanbul are connected)  
• From Istanbul to Stockholm (istambul and stockholm are connected)  
• From Stockholm to Santorini (using the directed “from stockholm to santorini”)  

The assignments of days are computed as follows. (Remember that when you fly on the last day of a city’s visit that same day is “in‐both cities.”) 

• City 1: Krakow for 5 days (the workshop in Krakow happens on Day 5) → Day 1–5  
• City 2: Vilnius for 5 days → starts on Day 5 (overlap with Krakow on Day 5) and runs Day 5–9  
• City 3: Frankfurt for 4 days → starts on Day 9 (overlap with Vilnius on Day 9) and runs Day 9–12  
• City 4: Florence for 2 days → starts on Day 12 (overlap on Day 12) and runs Day 12–13  
• City 5: Munich for 5 days → starts on Day 13 and runs Day 13–17  
• City 6: Hamburg for 5 days → starts on Day 17 and runs Day 17–21  
• City 7: Oslo for 5 days → starts on Day 21 and runs Day 21–25  
• City 8: Istanbul for 5 days → starts on Day 25 (so the annual show from Day 25–29 is “inside” this segment) and runs Day 25–29  
• City 9: Stockholm for 3 days → starts on Day 29 (overlap with Istanbul on Day 29) and runs Day 29–31  
• City 10: Santorini for 2 days → starts on Day 31 (overlap with Stockholm on Day 31) and runs Day 31–32

One can check that the “sum of days” (5+5+4+2+5+5+5+5+3+2 = 41) minus the 9 “overlap” days equals the 32‐day total. Also, every adjacent pair is connected by an available (direct) flight and all special date requirements are satisfied.

Below is the required JSON output:

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-5", "place": "Krakow"},
    {"day_range": "Day 5-9", "place": "Vilnius"},
    {"day_range": "Day 9-12", "place": "Frankfurt"},
    {"day_range": "Day 12-13", "place": "Florence"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-17", "place": "Munich"},
    {"day_range": "Day 17-21", "place": "Hamburg"},
    {"day_range": "Day 21-25", "place": "Oslo"},
    {"day_range": "Day 25-29", "place": "Istanbul"},
    {"day_range": "Day 29-31", "place": "Stockholm"},
    {"day_range": "Day 31-32", "place": "Santorini"}
  ]
}

This plan meets the requirements:
– The workshop in Krakow falls on Day 5 (the last day of Krakow’s visit, which is within [5,9]).  
– The annual show in Istanbul is attended exactly during Day 25–29.  
– Every commuting flight is direct (using the available direct flights listed).  

This is one acceptable solution.
